say:1:1224650001:0.text: Hey, are you here to prepare some healing potions? Lucca said you'd be coming, so I've got the herbs ready for you.
say:1:1224650001:0.source_cn: 哟！是来置办出航用的药品吗？卢卡和我打过招呼了，药材给...

document:0:89:0.text:
This brown elixir has a slightly bitter scent and can help restore energy. It is commonly used for treating post-battle wounds and is a must-have for travelers.
This potion is made from <style="stress">splitpod, swallow feather powder, and spirit root</style>. Each batch produces about 15 bottles, each containing a 10ml dose.
document:0:89:0.source_cn:
闻起来略带苦涩的棕色药剂，饮下可立即恢复一定气力，一般用于战后疗伤。旅人远行必备。
由<style="stress">裂松果，枯燕羽粉末，巨灵根</style>调配而成。一次调配可得约十五瓶，每瓶十毫升的剂量。

say:0:1224651001:0.text: Huff... There should be enough room for the equipment.
say:0:1224651001:0.source_cn: 呼……应该还有空间放装备。

say:1:1224652001:0.text: Magister! To what do I owe the pleasure?
say:1:1224652001:0.male: Magister! To what do I owe the pleasure?
say:1:1224652001:0.female: Magister! To what do I owe the pleasure?

say:2:1224652002:1.text: You seem busy helping people out these days.
say:2:1224652002:1.source_cn: 你好像挺忙的，总是看你帮这个帮那个。
say:2:1224652002:1.male: You seem busy helping people out these days.
say:2:1224652002:1.female: You seem busy helping people out these days.

say:3:1224652003:1.text: Well, Lucca told me you'd be coming. You can start when you're ready.
say:3:1224652003:1.source_cn: 今天帮卢卡吗？那家伙和我打过招呼了，你准备好了就开始吧。
say:3:1224652003:1.male: Well, Lucca told me you'd be coming. You can start when you're ready.
say:3:1224652003:1.female: Well, Lucca told me you'd be coming. You can start when you're ready.

say:0:1224653001:0.text: We've got the weapons and equipment. Time to return to Lucca!
say:0:1224653001:0.source_cn: 武器和装备都齐了，回去找卢卡吧！

say:2:1224654002:1.text: Thanks a bunch! With you pitching in, we got everything ready in no time.
say:2:1224654002:1.source_cn: 多谢！有你们搭把手，这次很快就准备齐全了。
say:2:1224654002:1.male: Thanks a bunch! With you pitching in, we got everything ready in no time.
say:2:1224654002:1.female: Thanks a bunch! With you pitching in, we got everything ready in no time.
